task_summary: Migrated ProposalTab selectors and status panels to shared shadcn Tabs, Alerts, semantic Badges, busy Buttons, and an accessible AlertDialog approval-scope guard. Proposal drafts, PDF generation, revision payload, locking, and refresh behavior are preserved. Focused tests pass 9/9; scoped ESLint and Prettier pass; production build passes with 4,853 modules; 16 SSR Playwright captures cover review, locked, revision, and empty states across light/dark desktop/mobile. Inventory: 139 source-updated, 3 reviewed-no-ui, 136 pending; full refactor remains active.
key_decisions: Used the shared Radix Tabs component for candidate proposal selection and tab panel semantics.
Replaced proposal revision and approval-lock palettes with shared Alert variants and semantic Badge variants.
Replaced native window.confirm for approved-scope unlocking with the shared accessible AlertDialog while retaining the warning and explicit confirmation.
Used the shared Button busy state for PDF generation and revision resubmission without changing their data and completion behavior.
lessons_learned: Radix Tabs tests must dispatch the mouse-down selection gesture or exercise keyboard navigation; a bare synthetic click does not reproduce the primitive selection path.
The approved-scope warning needs to stay visible and the fields disabled until the explicit AlertDialog action is confirmed.
open_threads: The full refactor remains active: 139/278 source modules are source-updated, 3 are reviewed-no-ui, and 136 remain pending.
Continue with PrototypeGalleryModal.jsx, then the remaining proposal/project/course workspaces and P8-P11 surfaces.
Complete final route-integrated visual audits and all governance, full test partition, evidence, and workspace gates.
